notes.title: Version 0.6.2 Patch #1 [11/11/24]
notes.content:
- Fixed Spawn Trap Type Kids (e.g. Math Wiz) spawning Traps at their own location when no Path tile is available (e.g. blocked by Item Trap Spawns like Trip Rope). They will just not spawn and show a warning.
- Fixed Flower Field Map's bridge & fence colliders to prevent Brats from getting stuck at the start of the bridge railings.
- Fixed Shops UI animation stuck bug in certain situations.
- Fixed Perk Rewards UI not showing and freezing the game in certain situations.
- Nerfed damage outputs of Rockstar, Violinist, and Pianist Elite Kids.
